messages:
IncidentBot: URGENT: Pager — elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts observed for gateway-prod (us-west-2). Alert: gateway.5xx.rate > 3% for 2m. Spike began ~00:24 UTC. Auto-pager to oncall-kate.
oncall-kate: Acked. I'm on it. @sre-alejandro you're up if you can join.
sre-alejandro: Looking at dashboards now — big increase in scheduler batch queue depth on sp-west-2 pool, head-of-line blocking showing up as long wait ages. Timeouts correlate with batch wait > 3s.
infra-desk: Infra metrics: CPU/network normal. GPU utilization high on 2 nodes in pool-4. KV cache size for model shards spiked recently. No node restarts.
eng-runtime: We merged a prefetch-window tweak ~2h ago to improve throughput; it's at 50% canary. That could extend batch lifetimes if it increases cache warmups.
oncall-kate: Can we pause that rollout? @DeployBot pause rollout prefetch-window on scheduler-pools please.
DeployBot: Rollout paused for change prefetch-window (run id 2026-03-15-09). No further canary promotions.
sre-alejandro: Live mitigation plan: 1) lower batch_max_latency to 30ms on affected pools; 2) aggressive eviction of oldest/low-priority queued requests; 3) enable temporary rate-limiting for non-SLA tiers.
eng-runtime: Applying scheduler config: ```POST /admin/scheduler/config
{ "pool": "sp-west-2", "batch_max_latency_ms": 30, "eviction_policy": "age-priority" }``` Expecting propagate ~20s.
infra-desk: Config applied to 6/8 nodes in sp-west-2. Observability: queue depth down ~45% in 40s, in-flight batches decreasing.
mike-support: Customer impact: Support queue showing ~180 error reports primarily from EU customers hitting routed endpoints. No top-tier customers showing major incidents yet; CS notified.
ops-lead: Suggest temporary gateway routing fallback: route high-p95 customers to stable-variant to lower token/time pressure.
eng-runtime: Implemented routing policy: header x-customer-tier == "gold" -> stable-variant; others -> fallback-quantized. Rule live in ~30s.
oncall-kate: Monitoring: 5xx rate dropping from 4.8% -> 1.2% over last 3m, timeout counts decreasing. Keep monitoring for regressions.
sre-alejandro: Traces show KV cache growth causing scheduler to wait on cache warmups for certain model shards; coupled with gateway retries this created a retry storm and HOL blocking.
eng-runtime: Rolling back prefetch-window change on remaining canary nodes and adding a hard eviction threshold when KV cache > 8GB.
ops-lead: Decision: rollback remaining canary, keep batch_max_latency 30ms for 30m, enable routing fallback until stable.
oncall-kate: Action items: create incident INC-20260315-314, update status page to "partial degradation" for us-west, CS to publish customer advisory.
mike-support: Advisory posted: "Intermittent increase in 5xx and timeouts affecting inference requests in us-west starting 00:24 UTC. Mitigations in progress." (status.redwood.com)
sre-alejandro: Leaving runbook link for follow-up: https://redwood/ops/runbooks/scheduler-hol. Will produce a postmortem once we've stabilized.
oncall-kate: Good work. I'll hand off to night oncall at 02:00 UTC; please add any follow-up notes. :white_check_mark: 
IncidentBot: Incident acknowledged by oncall-kate; elapsed 00:38. Auto-escalation set for 60m if 5xx > 2%.
ops-lead: Final check at 00:45 UTC: p95 latency improved, 5xx at 0.9%. Marking mitigated but will monitor for 1h.
